_news.title: Arabian Drilling shares rise as first quarter profit beats expectations

finsights.brief: Net income is expected to grow this year
Suffers from weak gross profit margins

summary: Arabian Drilling posted Q2 loss of SAR 31.5M vs. SAR 7M Q1 profit; revenue fell 6.9% to SAR 765M amid offshore rig suspensions.
Offshore revenue plunged 37.2% with negative 6% margin; land segment rose 8.2% with 14% margin as operational improvements took hold.
Three offshore rigs resumed operations post-quarter; management guides Q3 revenue up 4-6% with offshore utilization reaching 100%.
Backlog increased 7% YoY to SAR 11.8B; net debt-to-EBITDA peaked at 2.2x, expected to fall below 2.0x by year-end 2026.
Elephant Rig gas tender results due August for 11 rigs; dividend policy under board review after 2025 suspension to preserve cash.
